The Alignment Project - Clarification Questions V2.0 (PDF)

https://aisi.s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/0825/The+Alignment+Project+-+Clarification+Questions+V2.0+(1).pdf

States the GFA is between the funder(s) and the host organisation only, funds are paid directly to the host organisation, the project is a coalition of funders some of which accept for-profit applicants, for-profits may receive venture capital investment while non-profits receive grants, eligible applications go to the Research Sponsors for review and a formal assessment panel independent of the Research Sponsors reviews full applications.

Signals citing this source

  • UK AI Security Institute, F (for): Alignment Project grants are contracted and paid by each funder directly to the host organisation; DSIT/AISI's own grants are statutory grants under section 5 of the Science and Technology Act 1965 managed by an AISI research lead, and other funders issue their own terms, so OpenAI's £5.6m is not received into AISI's budget even though AISI runs the selection.“the Funding Agreement (GFA) will be between the funder(s) and the host organisation only”
